featured_reviews.review_text:
Mezban Restaurant is one of the best places in Nalasopara for delicious and freshly prepared food. The ambiance is simple yet comfortable, making it a great spot for both family dinners and casual hangouts with friends. The seating arrangement is spacious, and the cleanliness is always maintained well.

The menu offers a wide variety of dishes — from North Indian curries to Chinese and Tandoori specials. Each dish is cooked to perfection, with rich flavors and fresh ingredients that truly stand out. The chicken and mutton dishes here are a must-try for non-veg lovers, while vegetarians will find plenty of tasty options too.

The service is prompt, and the staff is friendly, attentive, and always ready to customize dishes as per your preference. Portion sizes are generous, making the food worth every penny you spend.

Their biryani is especially popular — aromatic, flavorful, and loaded with perfectly cooked meat and rice. Along with the main course, starters like kebabs, spring rolls, and crispy chicken are also crowd favorites.

The prices are reasonable, and considering the quality, it offers excellent value for money. They also provide takeaway and home delivery, which is quick and neatly packed.

Whether you are planning a family dinner, a celebration, or just craving some good food, Mezban Restaurant never disappoints. It’s a place you will want to visit again and again for its taste, hospitality, and overall dining experience.

Been reviewing since a long time and never have I ever gave such a terrific feedback to a restaurant that's good for nothing !

THE BISLERI WE ORDERED WAS THE ONLY ORDER WE LIKED AT THIS PLACE

Starting with the ambience, you will surely love this place if you go for looks and show off ! It has a dedicated space for kids to play but that is only when you want to go and try their food thats good for nothing !

So as usual, we ordered Masala Papad - Rating is 0.5 out of 5 because the Papad was just dripped out from oil and it had no masala as a topping, only sev, some tomato and onions along with 1.5-2 leaves of coriander ! They should change the name to Oily Masala Papad instead !

Secondly, we ordered Paneer Lababdar - In the picture, you will be able to see 17-18 chopped pieces of almonds, never have I ever seen this in a Paneer Lababdar recipe. Remember about these almonds, I'll tell you about it later.

Sorry youtube chefs if I missed out this part of recipe but the color, the gravy, the content itself was 0.1 out of 5 because the paneer was oil fried for the starters we order like Paneer Chilly but as this might be the Chefs first time to make Paneer Lababdar, he had to do the experiment on us ! I never used Fork and Spoon to cut a Paneer into 2 pieces, this time I did !

Remember I told you about the almonds ? They dissapeared when the vegetable was served to us, we were 3, one of the guy had a luck to eat 4-5 pieces, the rest is mistery !

Coming to the taste, don't know what was inside, one cannot guess what it was, the gravy was nothing but something that I cannot even express in words ! If you could say, it had a taste of tomato gravy ? No, it didnt. If you say it had something related to onions and coriander mixture ? No. Don't know what it was but I never ate Paneer Lababdar this bad ! Sorry I do not want to disrespect Food but the Restaurant, the Owner or anyone who handles the kitchen, must rethink about the chefs !

We order 1 butter roti each and that was all ! They do not serve Cold Drinks as they have Mocktails which I am sure would be another disappointment ! Thanks BISLERI to save us at some point !

We paid the bill and we left, not returning again to this place !

❌ Not Suggesting this place ❌

After this trauma, we went to MK Chinese Resturant near Nalasopara East D-Mart - Check the review on my profile !

Although there are lot of restaurants in Vasai-Virar near to beach but Bamboos Dhaba is a different vibe. The dhaba theme which has 4 sections like rooftop, ac hall, non Ac dine, bamboo huts 🛖 (best for couples or  families).
They have ample parking for bikes and four wheeler as well.
Don't miss live music which is almost 6days of week with change in performing artist everyday. Now coming to food review of Bamboos I would like to. mention a that
Authentic Indian flavors with a blend of traditional and modern touches, Dhaba Restaurant delivers an exceptional dining experience. Here's a breakdown of the dishes we tried:

Chicken Lollipop (4.8/5): This appetizer is a crowd-pleaser! The chicken was perfectly marinated, crispy on the outside, and tender inside. The flavors were bold with a perfect balance of spice and tang, making it an excellent starter to kick off the meal.

Chicken 65 (5/5): Absolutely outstanding! The Chicken 65 was fried to perfection—crispy, juicy, and full of flavor. The spices were just right, and it had the ideal level of heat. A must-try dish that clearly stands out on the menu.

Murgh Mussalam with Butter Naan (4.8/5): This main course was a true indulgence. The Murgh Mussalam was rich, aromatic, and tender, with the flavors of the gravy absorbing into the chicken beautifully. Paired with the soft, buttery naan, it was an indulgent treat. The slight reduction in rating is only because of the richness—it's perfect for those who enjoy bold, decadent flavors.

Guava & Lichi Flavored Soda (4/5): This drink was refreshing and a great complement to the spicy dishes. The guava and lychee combination was fruity and sweet, though it could have had a bit more punch in terms of flavor. Still, a great choice to balance out the heat of the food.

If you plan to visit, bring your own transport because getting a ride back at night is difficult. On the plus side, there is plenty of onsite parking.

The seating area is massive, with both indoor and outdoor options. They often host food festivals; during my visit, the first floor was reserved for a BBQ festival with a set menu and cover charge. There is also a small children’s play area, and the toilets are kept clean.

We tried the cocktails, mocktails, and starters, and everything tasted great. The Watermelon mint pint was a waste.

However, the staff felt a bit slow. There was also a frustrating issue with the outdoor music system when we were there. Another concern was the netting on the handrails. The tie wraps were not trimmed properly, and the sharp ends could easily scrape you if you aren't paying attention.

It's one of those places you would take family and friends for a treat. It's nice, spacious and get lively (especially weekends).

featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Rating: 1/5

I visited this restaurant to celebrate my birthday, and unfortunately, it turned into one of the worst dining experiences I’ve ever had.

Food

The food was mostly average. However, the chicken breast I ordered was extremely chewy and not tender at all. Other dishes were just okay.

Ambience

The ambience is the only good thing about this place.

Service — Absolutely Terrible

The service completely ruined my special day.
•	We had given our cake to be kept in the fridge in advance.
•	When we were seated, we were not even offered water.
•	While placing our appetizer order, we clearly requested that the cake be cut before the appetizers arrived — this was completely ignored.
•	Appetizers arrived first, still no water was served.
•	When we finally received the water bottle, no glasses were provided.
•	After repeated requests, only 4 glasses were given for a table of 7 people. We again had to ask for the remaining 3 glasses.
•	Even after raising this with the manager, the response was extremely slow and careless.
•	For a table of 7 people, we were asked to “adjust” with extra chairs and tables instead of being properly seated.

Towards the end, we requested a straw for a drink. The lady waiter kept roaming around empty tables, and we again had to call her and remind her about our request.

It was very evident that the staff was completely unfocused and poorly trained.

Food can be average and still acceptable — but service is what makes a restaurant good, and sadly this restaurant failed completely in that aspect.

Spend 6k for worst experience I have ever had. Never visiting here again.
Not recommended at all if you value basic hospitality and decent service.
